name: Chroma Bento
pitch: A live poster treemap sized by each model's share.
tradeoff: Tile area is a powered share so the smallest models stay readable.
fontWhy: Bricolage shouts the poster, Schibsted labels it, and Spline locks the digits.
logoIdea: A heavy one-stroke R whose leg ends in a sharp cut, the run stopping mid-stride.
sliderIdea: A chunky paper capsule whose day chips snap under two big thumbs.
signatureMotion: Tiles spring and reflow with overshoot while numerals split-flap.
